headline: Connecting farms, procurement and customers —
subhead: AgriConnect digitises the entire agricultural value chain: transparent open bidding, smart supplier allocation, graded produce commerce, and live market intelligence — all in one platform.

smartBidding.title: Smart Farmer Bidding
smartBidding.desc: Farmers bid openly on verified procurement requests with transparent rankings powered by our smart allocation engine.

b2b.title: B2B Procurement & Logistics
b2b.desc: Suppliers manage multi-farmer contracts, deliveries, and quality verification with a full audit trail.

marketplace.title: Graded Produce Marketplace
marketplace.desc: Customers buy farm-fresh, graded produce directly from suppliers with live inventory and doorstep delivery.

prices.title: Live Market Prices
prices.desc: Real-time and historical trends from AGMARKNET & eNAM help farmers and suppliers price with confidence.

farmers.title: Farmers
farmers.desc: Bid on live demands, win fair contracts, get paid on time.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.desc: Launch procurements, rank bids smartly, manage deliveries & inventory.

customers.title: Customers
customers.desc: Shop graded farm produce with transparent origin.
